about: Retrieval evaluation set for `python -m knowledge.evaluate`. Each query lists where the answer is: a document id from data/sources/catalog.json and a page range. A search counts as a hit if one of its top results comes from that document and overlaps those pages. The pages were found by reading the extracted text, not by running the search, so the set doesn't favour any model. `search_languages` limits the search to documents in those languages (cross-language tests); null means all. The off-topic queries have no answer: their best scores show how similar unrelated text looks, which MIN_RELEVANCE_SCORE must stay above.
